title: A busy family
text: Lan has a big family. Her mother is a teacher and her father is a driver. Her sister works in a café near the market. Her brother is a doctor at a small hospital. Lan has two neighbors, and they are also her friends. On Sundays her parents visit her. Her coworker Anna has a brother, but he lives in another city. Anna's brother is a shop assistant in a restaurant.

questions.explain: Her brother is a doctor at a small hospital.
On Sundays her parents visit her.
